qualification: Handwritten assertion-bearing candidates. Author/source/static evidence only; no SUT or reference-runtime execution. Independent review required for primary census credit.
oracle_policy: Fixed literal values are authored independently from API contracts. Source-gap notes never replace desired behavior. Generated multipart boundary randomness is normalized only through a bounded independent framing parser, which accepts standard optional final CRLF and header casing. No case is generated by a parameter sweep.
ordinary_input_scope: Tiny valid Blob/File/FormData/Request/Response inputs. All multipart examples are complete legal framing; arbitrary binary File bytes are allowed. No repeated use of consumed nonnull bodies, malformed input, auth, forgery, replay, transport fault, retained capability, guarded core path, outbound fetch, or host upload. Upload workflows are exercised as local Request bodies inside the direct Worker.

Mutate the backing Uint8Array after construction.
Assert fixed seven-byte value, byte length, and normalized type.
cases.distinctness: C016 already covers Blob view bounds, copied input and MIME normalization, and S005/H010 cover offset transport. None of those primitives earn new credit here. The distinct mechanism is ordered heterogeneous composition of a UTF-8 scalar string, DataView window, nested Blob bytes and trailing scalar string into one exact byte sequence.

cases.title: Convert Blob and File form entries while preserving file metadata
cases.mechanism: FormData File identity and explicit filename conversion
cases.hypothesis: Appending a File may gratuitously clone it or rename it in place; Blob conversion may omit the default filename or lose type/lastModified.
trace: Append one File unchanged and once with a new filename.
Append an ordinary Blob without filename.
Assert File identity/renaming, bytes, fixed lastModified, type, original metadata, and default blob filename.
cases.distinctness: Entry-value type and metadata conversion, which URLSearchParams and remote-stream cases do not implement.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(form.get('unchanged') === file, true, 'File append without filename preserves File identity');
t.equal(renamed instanceof File && renamed !== file, true, 'explicit filename creates a renamed File');
t.equal(renamed.name, 'upload.txt', 'explicit upload filename');
t.equal(renamed.lastModified, 123456789, 'renaming preserves File lastModified');
t.equal(renamed.type, 'text/plain', 'renaming preserves normalized type');
t.equal(await renamed.text(), 'hello', 'renaming preserves bytes');
t.equal(file.name, 'original.txt', 'original File metadata unchanged');
t.equal(form.get('default').name, 'blob', 'plain Blob becomes File with default name');
t.equal(form.get('default').type, 'application/x-raw', 'Blob-to-File entry retains type');
cases.application_relevance: Workers assemble uploads with user files, renamed attachments, and generated Blobs.
cases.desired_behavior: Unrenamed File is identical; renamed File is distinct upload.txt with unchanged bytes/type/123456789 lastModified; plain Blob is named blob.
cases.source_observation: Pinned form-value conversion returns a File directly without a filename override and creates a new File for overrides or Blobs. The lastModified assertion is specifically the source-supported same-file metadata carry-through at harness.js 10899-10906; HTML create-an-entry independently supports identity/rename/bytes but does not spell out lastModified. This supporting assertion earns no separate case credit.

cases.title: Dispatch a URLSearchParams BodyInit through its inferred form media type
cases.mechanism: Typed BodyInit extraction, media-type inference, and Body.formData dispatch
cases.hypothesis: A typed query object may be stringified without its media type, consulted after mutation, or routed to the wrong body parser.
trace: Construct a POST Request from two simple params, clone it, then change the original params.
Assert inferred media type and exact construction-time clone text.
Consume original through formData and assert output class, pairs, and bodyUsed.
cases.distinctness: U209/U210 test parameter algorithms directly; this has deliberately plain values and tests the Request/Body integration seam and snapshot.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(request.headers.get('content-type'), 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8', 'URLSearchParams BodyInit infers its form media type');
t.equal(await t.consume(copy, 'text'), 'event=launch&count=2', 'typed extraction snapshots URLSearchParams serialization');
t.equal(form instanceof FormData, true, 'Body formData dispatch recognizes inferred media type');
t.deep([...form], [['event', 'launch'], ['count', '2']], 'typed body parses to FormData rather than re-reading source params');
t.equal(request.bodyUsed, true, 'form body consumer marks request used');
cases.application_relevance: Workers construct URL-encoded event submissions from a reusable parameter object.
cases.desired_behavior: Media type application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8; body event=launch&count=2; parsed FormData has those two fields.
cases.source_observation: Pinned __typedBody has a distinct URLSearchParams branch and formData has a media-type dispatch path.

cases.title: Transfer inherited Request bodies while leaving overridden sources unused
cases.mechanism: Request constructor body ownership transfer versus explicit replacement
cases.hypothesis: The buffered prior-Request path may silently copy bytes instead of transferring body ownership like the streaming path.
trace: Construct a POST Request with buffered body and construct another Request from it without replacement.
Assert original becomes bodyUsed, destination starts unused, and inherited text survives.
Construct a second source and explicit-body replacement; assert source stays unused and each distinct payload is readable.
cases.distinctness: Request ownership transfer, absent from H008 clone-to-independent-upload and V215 cache clone consumption.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(original.bodyUsed, true, 'constructing from Request without replacement transfers its body');
t.equal(moved.bodyUsed, false, 'new Request owns an initially unused transferred body');
t.equal(await t.consume(moved, 'text'), 'inherited', 'transferred body retains payload');
t.equal(source.bodyUsed, false, 'explicit replacement body leaves prior body undisturbed');
t.equal(await t.consume(source, 'text'), 'old', 'original remains consumable when body is overridden');
t.equal(await t.consume(replacement, 'text'), 'new', 'replacement body is used by new Request');
cases.application_relevance: Workers wrap an incoming request or deliberately replace its payload before forwarding.
cases.desired_behavior: Inherited body transfers and marks source used; explicit replacement does not disturb its separate source.
cases.source_observation: Pinned constructor marks prior used only when prior._bodyBytes is null; buffered input instead uses slice(). Static discrepancy hypothesis only.

cases.title: Preserve cloned Response metadata while isolating mutable consumer results
cases.mechanism: Buffered Response clone metadata and result-buffer ownership
cases.hypothesis: A clone may share its header list, omit status metadata, or expose mutable consumed buffers that alter the original body.
trace: Clone a three-byte response carrying explicit status, statusText, and an ordinary custom header.
Modify clone headers and assert original header plus clone status metadata.
Consume clone bytes and mutate them; assert original is unused and its later bytes remain exact.
cases.distinctness: V215 checks Cache.put consumes only the supplied clone; its clone-read subcheck is not new credit here. New mechanisms are clone metadata/header-list independence and byte-result mutation ownership, with no Cache API.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(response.headers.get('x-mode'), 'original', 'response clone owns a separate header list');
t.equal(copy.status, 201, 'response clone preserves status');
t.equal(copy.statusText, 'Created', 'response clone preserves statusText');
t.equal(response.bodyUsed, false, 'consuming clone leaves source body unused');
t.deep([...new Uint8Array(await t.consume(response, 'arrayBuffer'))], [9, 8, 7], 'clone consumer buffer edits cannot alter source body');
t.equal(copy.bodyUsed, true, 'clone consumed state is independent');
cases.application_relevance: Workers branch a buffered response for independent middleware annotations and byte inspection.
cases.desired_behavior: Header lists are independent; status 201/Created survives; original bytes stay [9,8,7] after clone-result mutation.
cases.source_observation: Pinned clone rebuilds a Response from copied bytes and copied init metadata. Its ordinary no-cache ownership assertions are the primary test.

cases.title: Snapshot JSON response data while retaining response initialization
cases.mechanism: Response.json eager serialization and response initialization composition
cases.hypothesis: Response.json may retain a mutable object instead of serialized bytes or discard supplied status/headers.
trace: Construct a JSON response from an object with nested array and explicit status/header.
Mutate both source object and nested array.
Assert response init values, media type, fixed JSON bytes, and consumed body state.
cases.distinctness: Structured JSON serialization snapshot, not generic string extraction or Blob composition.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(response.status, 202, 'Response.json retains supplied status');
t.equal(response.headers.get('content-type'), 'application/json', 'Response.json provides JSON content type');
t.equal(response.headers.get('x-job'), 'queued', 'Response.json preserves supplied metadata');
t.equal(await t.consume(response, 'text'), '{"order":7,"tags":["ready"]}', 'JSON response serializes object once at construction');
t.equal(response.bodyUsed, true, 'JSON response body consumption is tracked');
cases.application_relevance: Workers return queued-job acknowledgments and then continue mutating the original application object.
cases.desired_behavior: Status 202 and x-job queued; body exactly {"order":7,"tags":["ready"]}; application/json media type.
cases.source_observation: Pinned static json serializes immediately and supplies JSON type unless present.

cases.title: Keep absent bodies distinct from empty streams and never disturbed
cases.mechanism: Null Body representation and bodyUsed semantics
cases.hypothesis: Body consumers may set a boolean used flag even with no stream, or a bodyless POST may be represented as an empty stream.
trace: Construct null-body 204 response, read empty text and empty ArrayBuffer, and assert body stays null and bodyUsed false.
Construct POST without BodyInit and assert null body and false bodyUsed.
cases.distinctness: Presence/absence representation, not a nonempty body replay or malformed use.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(response.body, null, 'null Response has no stream');
t.equal(await t.consume(response, 'text'), '', 'consuming absent body yields empty text');
t.equal(response.bodyUsed, false, 'absent body cannot become disturbed');
t.equal((await t.consume(response, 'arrayBuffer')).byteLength, 0, 'null body remains available as empty bytes');
t.equal(response.bodyUsed, false, 'second null-body conversion still has no disturbed stream');
t.equal(request.body, null, 'POST with no BodyInit has absent rather than empty-stream body');
t.equal(request.bodyUsed, false, 'bodyless Request starts unused');
cases.application_relevance: Workers return 204 acknowledgments and construct bodyless POST operations.
cases.desired_behavior: Absent bodies have no stream and cannot become disturbed; conversions yield empty values.
cases.source_observation: Pinned consumers assign bodyUsed=true unconditionally; Request creates a CelldBodyStream for POST even without body. Static discrepancy hypothesis only.

cases.title: Reflect direct body-reader disturbance in Response.bodyUsed
cases.mechanism: Body state derived from ReadableStream disturbance
cases.hypothesis: A stored bodyUsed flag may remain false when the body is read through its public stream instead of a convenience consumer.
trace: Construct a three-byte response and acquire a tracked reader.
Assert acquiring alone leaves bodyUsed false.
Read once, assert nonempty data and bodyUsed true, then bounded-drain and verify bytes and persistent disturbed state.
Cancel/release tracked reader on every exit.
cases.distinctness: Stream-to-Body state coupling, not H011 text consumption or S-series remote stream behavior.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(response.bodyUsed, false, 'acquiring a reader alone does not disturb body');
t.equal(first.done, false, 'nonempty body provides bytes before EOF');
t.equal(response.bodyUsed, true, 'direct reader consumption is reflected by Body.bodyUsed');
t.deep(all, [21, 22, 23], 'body state tracking does not change payload');
t.equal(response.bodyUsed, true, 'disturbed state persists at EOF');
cases.application_relevance: Workers incrementally inspect a body through getReader and use bodyUsed to decide later routing.
cases.desired_behavior: bodyUsed is false before read and true after read/EOF; full bytes [21,22,23].
cases.source_observation: Pinned bodyUsed is assigned by convenience methods but CelldBodyStream does not update its owner when a reader disturbs it. Static discrepancy hypothesis only.

cases.title: Infer text BodyInit media types while preserving an explicit override
cases.mechanism: String BodyInit default content-type and caller override precedence
cases.hypothesis: The string extraction fast path may omit the standard text media type or overwrite an explicitly supplied type.
trace: Construct one implicit-type string Response, an explicit-type control Response, and one string POST Request.
Assert inferred text media types and preserved explicit type.
Consume all three and assert fixed text without transcoding.
cases.distinctness: Scalar-string extraction and MIME inference, separate from URLSearchParams typed-form dispatch and JSON static helper.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(inferred.headers.get('content-type'), 'text/plain;charset=UTF-8', 'string Response BodyInit infers text media type');
t.equal(request.headers.get('content-type'), 'text/plain;charset=UTF-8', 'string Request BodyInit infers text media type');
t.equal(explicit.headers.get('content-type'), 'text/x-fixture', 'explicit content type takes precedence over inferred type');
t.equal(await t.consume(inferred, 'text'), 'hello', 'inference does not alter string body');
t.equal(await t.consume(request, 'text'), 'hello', 'request extraction retains string bytes');
t.equal(await t.consume(explicit, 'text'), 'hello', 'explicit media type does not transcode body');
cases.application_relevance: Workers construct ordinary text requests and responses that downstream clients interpret by their media type.
cases.desired_behavior: Implicit string bodies infer text/plain;charset=UTF-8; explicit text/x-fixture remains; all bytes spell hello.
cases.source_observation: Pinned MIME inference is only triggered for __typedBody object kinds; the string fast path does not assign a content type. Static discrepancy hypothesis only.

cases.title: Clone a valid finite streaming Response and settle both bodies
cases.mechanism: Response.clone support for unused non-buffered Body streams
cases.hypothesis: Response.clone may reject an unused valid stream solely because the body has not been buffered.
trace: Create a finite stream that eagerly enqueues two two-byte chunks and closes.
Construct a Response and clone it before any read.
Assert both bodies are unused, then join both consumers with allSettled.
Assert successful terminal outcomes, exact four-byte arrays, and clone metadata.
cases.distinctness: Response.clone unsupported-source path, unlike H008 Request.clone followed by two committed host uploads, S017 remote tee, or buffered Cache.put ownership.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(response.bodyUsed, false, 'cloning leaves original response body unused');
t.equal(copy.bodyUsed, false, 'cloned streaming response starts unused');
t.deep(results.map(result => result.status), ['fulfilled', 'fulfilled'], 'both finite clone consumers settle successfully before cleanup');
t.deep([...new Uint8Array(results[0].value)], [10, 20, 30, 40], 'original branch has complete finite local payload');
t.deep([...new Uint8Array(results[1].value)], [10, 20, 30, 40], 'cloned branch has complete finite local payload');
t.equal(copy.status, 203, 'streaming clone preserves response status');
t.equal(copy.headers.get('x-origin'), 'local-stream', 'streaming clone preserves ordinary metadata');
cases.application_relevance: Workers clone a streaming response for two ordinary consumers within one active request.
cases.desired_behavior: Clone succeeds; both consumers settle fulfilled with [10,20,30,40]; status 203 and x-origin local-stream preserved.
cases.source_observation: Pinned Response.clone explicitly throws when _bodyBytes is null, despite the source being unused. Static discrepancy hypothesis only.
